limitations: The theorem concerns the 3d² standard coordinate-pairing lines and their reduced incidence strata, not extra lines of exceptional Fermat surfaces, Jacobian singular schemes, or the ambient surface zeta function. Odd characteristic prime to d and d≥3 are required. Historical priority of an equivalent general motivic class is not conclusively established.
scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof given with explicit finite-étale normalization and scissor calculation. Finite checks support but do not prove generality. No independent audit or publication is claimed.
title: A motivic normalization formula for the standard-line divisor on Fermat surfaces
